items.scope: ADL PC/fetch, JP/JR/CALL/RET and ordinary RST

items.scope: MBASE access, STMIX/RSMIX and canonical mixed CALL/RET

items.scope: Peripheral RST/CALL and unsupported-opcode response in ADL/MADL contexts
